description: This file defines an interface named ICatalogItemViewModelService, which specifies a contract for services handling catalog item view models within the eShopWeb application. It includes a method for updating catalog items asynchronously.

classes.name: ICatalogItemViewModelService
classes.description: An interface defining methods related to catalog item view models, particularly for updating catalog items asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateCatalogItem
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a catalog item using the provided CatalogItemViewModel.
